question_record.context: 'CommandAndControl' malware was detected on the device `vnevado-win10s` with AadDeviceId `f5b847aa-8712-4bf6-b4f7-ed6cd89e1505`, which may indicate an attacker attempting to move laterally from another device in the network. The process ID associated with this activity is `6460` and it was created at `2024-06-20T09:10:51.7817908Z` with the command line `curl http://vectorsandarrows.com`.
question_record.question: Related to this malware detection, it is observed that potentially compromised assets are exhibiting ransomware-like behavior. Can you identify the name of the file involved in this ransomware activity?
solution: The user account with AadUserId `731adb71-b11c-4bbf-850b-57989b350e96` was involved in an incident where 'CommandAndControl' malware was detected during lateral movement.
A file named `kiters.7z.lockbit` was detected exhibiting ransomware-like behavior on potentially compromised assets.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
